definitions.short: a burrower , i.e. probably a rat
definitions.full: H2661. chaphor [ חֲפַרְמָּרָה ] noun feminine mole (as digger ) — only Isa 2:20 , read לַחֲפַרְמָּרוֺת ( מֵּרוֺת לַחְמֹּר ᵑ0 , meaning obscure, see conjectures in Thes Ges Comm. Di).
definitions.rootNote: from 2658 ; a hole ; only in connection with 6512 , which ought rather to be joined as one word, thus חַפַרְפֵּרָה ; by reduplication from 2658 ;
